professionalSummary: Experienced Support Operations Coordinator with a proven track record of compiling weekly backlog reports, maintaining macro libraries, designing routing rules, conducting user acceptance testing, and delivering new-agent inductions. Demonstrated ability to implement ticket-routing changes and monitor their impact in a live customer-facing queue.
experienceHighlights: Compiled weekly backlog reports for four support leads, detailing open tickets by age band and first-response times against published targets (src_03ea4c510e46).

Rewrote and maintained approximately 120 macros in the helpdesk platform, retiring duplicates and adding placeholders for customer plans and regions; macro usage reviewed quarterly (src_d66e1ec2063e).
Designed language- and plan-based routing rules in the helpdesk sandbox, replaying three months of historical tickets to compare queue assignments (src_415298893314).
Organised two rounds of user acceptance testing with eight support agents in the sandbox, logging defects in the IT tracker and retesting fixes before sign-off (src_3404a4b42395).
Delivered a half-day tooling induction to every intake of new agents in 2024, covering views, macros and escalation paths (src_ad16fbdae905).
projectsAndWorkSamples: UAT sign-off pack for routing rules, including test scripts, defect log and agents' sign-off sheets, all run in the sandbox; last page indicates go-live readiness for EMEA queue (src_b379668095b1).
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume, work sample, and notes establish the candidate’s experience in backlog reporting, macro maintenance, routing rule design, UAT, and agent training, but do not confirm live deployment of routing changes or monitoring post-release in a customer-facing queue.

evidence.text: Compiled the weekly backlog report for four support leads, showing open tickets by age band and first-response times against the published targets.

Rewrote and maintained about 120 macros in the helpdesk platform, retiring duplicates and adding placeholders for the customer's plan and region; usage of each macro was reviewed every quarter from the helpdesk's macro report.

missingEvidence: Evidence that a ticket-routing or automation change was deployed to a live customer-facing support queue and monitored after release.

Delivered a half-day tooling induction to every intake of new agents in 2024 (five intakes), covering views, macros and escalation paths.
